items.definition: A motorized two-wheeled road vehicle steered by handlebars and powered by an engine.
A lightweight motorized two-wheeler, often equipped with pedals and limited engine power.
A single-wheeled vehicle balanced and propelled by a rider using pedals.
A three-wheeled human-powered vehicle, commonly ridden by children or used for cargo.
A short board mounted on four small wheels, ridden standing and propelled by foot pushes.
A narrow standing platform with handlebars and small wheels, propelled by pushing against the ground.
A small, low, open motor vehicle built for racing on compact tracks.
A lightweight passenger cart pulled or pedaled by a person, commonly used for short trips.
A road vehicle with an enclosed body, usually carrying a small number of passengers.
A large road vehicle designed to carry many passengers along scheduled or chartered routes.
A motor vehicle built primarily to transport cargo in a separate bed or compartment.
A box-shaped road vehicle with an enclosed cargo area or several passenger seats.
A series of connected rail vehicles pulled or pushed along a track by a locomotive.
A powered aircraft with fixed wings that travels through the air carrying people or cargo.
A small watercraft used for travel, recreation, fishing, or carrying people and supplies.
A powerful farm vehicle designed to pull equipment and perform work across fields.
A vehicle equipped to transport patients and provide emergency medical care en route.
A large emergency response vehicle carrying hoses, water, ladders, and firefighting equipment.
A passenger vehicle available for hire, typically taking customers to chosen destinations.
An aircraft lifted and propelled by horizontally rotating overhead blades.
A watercraft propelled primarily by wind acting on sails attached to a mast.
A narrow, lightweight watercraft paddled by seated occupants using single-bladed paddles.
A motorized vehicle with skis and a continuous track for traveling over snow.
A commercial road vehicle used to carry parcels or goods to homes and businesses.
Protective headwear with a hard shell and shock-absorbing lining, worn to reduce impact injuries.
A hand tool with shaped jaws or a socket for turning nuts and bolts.
A device that compresses and moves air into tires or other inflatable objects.
A small rigid tool used to lift a tire bead over a wheel rim.
A fastening device opened by a key, combination, or electronic credential.
A reusable narrow-necked container for carrying drinking liquid.
A close-fitting athletic shirt designed for comfort and moisture control during riding.
A fixed or portable frame that holds bicycles upright or secures them for storage.
A large deciduous or evergreen tree bearing lobed leaves and producing acorns.
A thorny flowering shrub with fragrant blossoms and fleshy fruits called hips.
A crisp, round fruit with edible flesh and a central core containing seeds.
A curved, soft-fleshed tropical fruit that grows in clusters beneath a peel.
A piece of furniture with a raised seat, backrest, and usually four supporting legs.
A small four-stringed instrument played with a bow and held beneath the chin.
An intelligent, air-breathing marine mammal with a streamlined body and a long snout.
A small social insect that lives in colonies and has elbowed antennae.
